transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve become convinced that an MBA classmate and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. Things they say in class, or messages on Slack, feel like coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. I know it sounds hard to explain, but it feels very real to me.
About how long have you been noticing these coded signals and messages?
About two months now, since I started the part-time MBA prerequisite program while still working my operations job.
During these past two months, have you heard any voices or sounds when no one else was around?
A few times a week, usually when I’m working late, I hear my name or a short phrase like, “go now,” really clearly. I’ll check my phone or look around, but no one’s there.
During these past two months, have you felt unusually high, elated, or on top of the world?

Yeah, most days I’ve felt kind of unusually switched on and optimistic, like I’m right on the edge of something huge. But I’ve also been snapping at my teammates or my boyfriend over little delays that normally wouldn’t get to me.
Have you been using any recreational drugs or non-prescribed substances recently?
No, I haven’t been using any recreational drugs or anything that wasn’t prescribed to me.
Before these past two months, have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt deeply down, depressed, or lost interest in things?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a time like that lasting two weeks.
Before these past two months, have you ever had a time in your life where you felt this energized, high, or had a decreased need for sleep?
I don’t think so. I can’t remember having another period like this before.
Have you noticed the coded signals or heard the voices during times when your mood and energy felt completely normal?

No. Before I started feeling this energized and driven, I hadn’t had the coded messages or heard my name when nobody was there. It only started after my mood and workload changed with the MBA prerequisite classes.
